subject: Executive briefing windows + MAP alignment for Acme close sprint
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on MAP + EB windows for close sprint

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the evaluation plan you suggested. We need to lock a mutual action plan and an executive briefing (EB) slot to hit our internal board decision date on 2028-07-22. High-level asks from Acme:

- MAP that lists milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria (security, perf, PII handling)
- An EB with our CIO + head of procurement during the week of 2028-07-08 (ideally early in the week)
- A short canary evaluation the week before the EB to validate integrations and throughput (3 business days)

Can you share a draft MAP and proposed EB time windows? Also include a rough token/cost estimate for the eval so procurement can provision a P.O.

Attachments: brief outline of our decision gates (Acme_Decision_Gates.pdf)

Cheers,
Lisa
Lisa Gomez
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
Phone: +1 415 555 0147

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on MAP + EB windows for close sprint

Hi Lisa — great to hear the demo landed well.

We can absolutely support that cadence. I attached an initial MAP draft (MAP_Acme_v1.docx) with proposed owners and acceptance criteria. Key highlights:

- Canary eval: 3 business day run, isolated tenant, sample workload from Acme (we'll need the sample prompt set + target latency SLO).
- EB windows (proposed): 2028-07-09 09:00–10:00 PT, 2028-07-10 13:00–14:00 PT, 2028-07-11 08:30–09:30 PT. I exported those as an .ics and attached (EB_slots_proposed.ics).
- Risk callouts: procurement needs a token estimate and a short scope for the dedicated eval instance; our default pricing for a 3-day eval with reserved capacity is listed in the MAP (section 5).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred EB slot and attendee list (CIO + procurement + security).
2) We finalize the MAP and share a PDF for your board packet the week of 2028-06-25.
3) We schedule the canary eval window the week prior to the EB (2028-07-02 to 2028-07-06).

I'll loop Rishi on the procurement/contracting details so we can get a quick P.O. ready.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: MAP_Acme_v1.docx

From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lisa Gomez <lisa@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning on MAP + EB windows for close sprint

Vanessa,

Thanks — the proposed windows look doable. Quick details from procurement side:

- Procurement lead: Tom Bennett (me) and Sr. Contracts Counsel: erin.contracts@acme.com (I'll add on the invite once slot is locked).
- For the eval token estimate we need an itemized estimate of compute + networking for a 3-day run (including endpoint concurrency guidance). If you can give a conservative / high estimate too that helps.
- Security will want a one-page evidence pack for SOC2 controls and data handling; can that be part of the MAP appendix?

Confirmed preference: EB on 2028-07-09 09:00–10:00 PT if that slot remains free. Please send calendar invites with dial-in + pre-read link.

Tom
Tom Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 May 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on MAP + EB windows for close sprint

Vanessa / Rishi — internal coordination notes (keeping thread for context):

- Rishi: can you confirm the procurement P.O. flow and whether legal needs any special redlines for an evaluation instance? If we need a short eval Addendum, I'll have the contract team prepare it.
- Rishi / Marissa: Ops side — allocate a dedicated evaluation pod in us-west-2 for 2028-07-02 to 2028-07-06; include 95th percentile throughput headroom for Acme's expected concurrency (I confirmed with Sales Solutions that their sample test uses 80 concurrent sessions).
- Security: attach SOC2 evidence zip to the MAP appendix; Vanessa, I'll create the one-pager summarizing retention, logging, and key controls.

Also drafting a short EB run-of-show: 20 min exec presentation, 15 min questions, 25 min demo with live metrics. We should stub in a 90-minute block to avoid tight transitions.

I'll update the MAP draft and push FINAL by 2028-05-10.

-M

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa@acme.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on MAP + EB windows for close sprint

Lisa / Tom — locking this down per confirmations. Summary and artifacts attached: MAP_Acme_v1_FINAL.pdf (finalized acceptance criteria and responsibilities) and EB_slots_proposed.ics (single invite for 2028-07-09 09:00–10:30 PT).

Action items completed now:
- EB scheduled: 2028-07-09 09:00–10:30 PT (invite sent to Lisa, Tom, Acme CIO placeholder).
- Canary eval: scheduled 2028-07-02 to 2028-07-05 (we shortened to 4 business days to accommodate constraints; sample workload request sent to Acme).
- Procurement: Rishi will follow up with an evaluation addendum and conservative token/compute estimate by 2028-05-12.
- Security appendix: Marissa will attach SOC2 evidence and a 1-page data handling summary to the MAP.

Please reply if anything needs to change — otherwise we'll treat the MAP as the source of truth for gating the board packet. Looking forward to the run.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_Acme_v1_FINAL.pdf, EB_slots_proposed.ics
